4380: fn (mut g FlatGen) shared_dup_fns() {
4381: 	names := g.sorted_shared_wrapper_names()
4382: 	if names.len == 0 {
4383: 		return
4384: 	}
4385: 	for name in names {
4386: 		g.writeln('static inline void* __dup${name}(void* src, int sz) {')
4387: 		g.writeln('#if defined(_VPREALLOC)')
4388: 		g.writeln('\t${name}* dest = (${name}*)malloc((size_t)sz);')
4389: 		g.writeln('#else')
4390: 		g.writeln('\t${name}* dest = (${name}*)malloc_uncollectable((ptrdiff_t)sz);')
4391: 		g.writeln('#endif')
4392: 		g.writeln('\tmemcpy(dest, src, (size_t)sz);')
4393: 		g.writeln('\tsync__RwMutex__init(&dest->mtx);')
4394: 		g.writeln('\treturn dest;')
4395: 		g.writeln('}')
4396: 	}
4397: 	g.writeln('')
